summary: Frontend-only test of Deskly planner whitespace/zoom/plan-comments round @1920x1080. All 6 items pass. Right col = Seating options then planner-insight-panel (Why this score). planner-info-row = planner-key-panel (583px) + saved-plans-panel (933px), equal heights, insight panel not in row. Saved plans: name+notes saves saved-plan-0 with notes in plan-notes-0, inputs clear; editing plan-notes-0 persists after reload; load-plan-btn-0 restores seating; delete-plan-btn-0 removes. Zoom: plain wheel stays 100%; ctrl+wheel over room-scroll zoomed to 272% with cursor anchor preserved (0.75,0.3997 -> 0.7499,0.3991); room-scroll scrollable (scrollWidth 3751 > clientWidth 1532, pan works); zoom-in caps at 300% (button disabled), zoom-out 300->240%, reset -> 100%. While zoomed (125%/156%), seat drag seat-0-0 -> table 1 works and table-group drag moves position. Full screen button present. No page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: RoomViewport onWheel mutates anchor ref inside setZoom updater (side effect in updater; harmless but impure under StrictMode)
handleUpdatePlanNotes writes localStorage on every keystroke (fine for local data; debounce optional)
Reload returns to home page (no URL routing) - pre-existing behaviour
seed_data_creation: TEST_Zoom class in browser localStorage only (ephemeral contexts)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iterations 1-14 passed. After reload use home-open-planner-btn -> class-arrange-btn-0 to reopen planner. Seats: seat-{g}-{s}, tables: table-group-{g} (drag via .table-surface).
